caveats: The exact V3 task-row artifact was unavailable from the local Research store, so this page publishes the reviewed aggregate and exact digest without reconstructing task rows.
The judge is advisory, infrastructure release gates are separate, and this study cannot attribute the whole-release result to one 0.4 feature.
findings: Evidence integrity passed and bounded inventory plus Evaluation reconciliation improved, but the candidate still regressed behaviorally and the release stayed on HOLD.
Candidate full deterministic passes were 1/8; aligned pairs were zero improved, one regressed, and seven unchanged; seven candidate attempts retained critical failures.
hypothesis: Structured queries, projected reads, and evaluation reconciliation in 0.4 may improve bounded maintenance investigation without weakening factual correctness.

authored_judge.summary: The blind maintainer judge remains advisory pending human calibration and cannot rescue deterministic failures.

decision.summary: Behavioral verdict REGRESSED; package release decision HOLD; no larger confirmation was run.

deterministic.summary: The candidate passed every required dimension in 1/8 attempts, retained seven critical failures, and regressed one aligned pair.

evidence_integrity.summary: All 16 attempts and 80 required evidence links reconciled with grade A lineage and privacy integrity.

infrastructure.summary: Local Docker through Harbor completed 16/16 planned cells at an observed cost of $7.331252.

mechanism.summary: Evaluation reconciliation and bounded inventory improved to 2/2; exact history did not improve and failure triage remained unbounded.

question: Does exact W&B MCP 0.4 help Claude Code answer bounded W&B and Weave maintenance questions more reliably than exact main?
summary: A governed 16-cell maintainer comparison in which evidence integrity passed, two behavior dimensions improved, exact-history correctness regressed, and the release decision remained HOLD.

title: W&B MCP main versus 0.4 V10
why_it_matters: A release can improve mechanisms and evidence integrity while still failing its behavioral gate; the decision must preserve all four ledgers.
